1864-2034-2054.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.

1453-2034-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2034-4694-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 1.

4694-4802-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.

When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-2292-5220-7492.description:
Cast Viscera Seer by paying its mana cost.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.

Cast Ultron either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Ultron enters, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Robot Villain creature token.

Resolve the Prowler ability, causing it to connive.

Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.

3259-4053-6633-7604.description:

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-6633-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Change of Heart, returning it to your hand.

If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.

Activate nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.

Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
